coverage: Reported business segments · segment revenue before inter-segment revenue
definition: Each segment's profit as Pidilite reports it, before costs and income not allocated to segments, finance cost, exceptional items and tax. The rows add up to ₹4,066.33 crore, which becomes profit for the year of ₹2,470.72 crore once those items and tax are taken off. It is not profit after tax.

rows.name: Consumer & Bazaar (products sold mainly to everyday users such as carpenters, painters, plumbers and households)
Business to Business (products sold mainly to large business users)
Others (mainly sale of raw materials and a non-banking finance company)

location: Annual report 2025–26, PDF page 251 (printed page 251), consolidated statement of profit and loss; PDF page 298 (printed page 298), note 46 segment information; PDF page 291, note 39 exceptional items; PDF page 315, note 55(d) and (e)
notes: Figures are reported in ₹ crore and are not converted. Segment revenue of ₹14,845.40 crore is before ₹244.57 crore of inter-segment revenue, sold at cost plus a fixed margin; revenue from operations after removing it is ₹14,600.83 crore. From segment result of ₹4,066.33 crore the filing takes off unallocable expenses of ₹1,006.10 crore and adds unallocable income of ₹294.07 crore (operating income ₹3,354.30 crore), then takes off finance cost ₹36.16 crore and its share of losses of associates and joint ventures ₹2.37 crore and adds interest and dividend income ₹18.11 crore, giving profit before exceptional items and tax of ₹3,333.88 crore. Exceptional items of ₹13.71 crore leave profit before tax of ₹3,320.17 crore; tax of ₹849.45 crore leaves profit for the year of ₹2,470.72 crore. Of this, ₹2,448.92 crore belongs to the company's owners and ₹21.80 crore to minority owners of subsidiaries. The exceptional items are write-downs: ₹5.73 crore on a loan to, and ₹7.98 crore on investments in, associate companies. Separately, the new Labour Codes (the government's revised labour laws, notified 21 November 2025) raised provisions for retirement pay and paid leave by ₹39.82 crore and ₹23.02 crore in employee benefits expense, plus ₹16.76 crore in other expenses for contract and outsourced workers, ₹79.60 crore in all; the company did not treat this as an exceptional item. There were no transactions with a single customer of 10% or more of revenue. Pidilite does not disclose profit for any single brand.
insight: Consumer & Bazaar brings in most of the segment revenue and nearly all of the segment result. Business to Business earns a much smaller result on its revenue, and Others made a small loss, so revenue alone does not show where the profit comes from.
